prompts.solid: Use case: stylized-concept. A production painted material source atlas for a dark, tactile independent pixel game, not a game screenshot. Square 1024 or larger opaque RGB neutral grayscale, fill the entire image, no border no labels no objects or characters. Material is dead, tightly compressed SHORT SOFT FELT FIBRES, like rough torn wool felt and compressed tow; fibres group into irregular medium-scale bent bunches. Each bunch spans about one sixteenth to one eighth of image width, with smaller short supple strands following that local direction. Show quiet compressed regions, broad soft value masses and selective torn fibre ends so the material survives downsampling to 128px. No stony mottling, no flakes, no bark chips, no splintered wood, no shredded leaves, no particulate stipple, no knitted loops or regular weave, no uniform brush-comb grooves, no sharp engraved stripes. Matte tactile painted shading with restrained diffuse illumination, grayscale only, moderate dark-to-light contrast, no bloom or dramatic cast shadow, no black holes. Must feel interlocked fibrous, never mineral or watery. Composition: one continuous material atlas in two bands with NO separator. Upper 45%: broad contiguous compressed felt SKIN, predominantly lying along local softly bending directions, dense yet flattened soft fibre bunches, occasional quiet worn areas. Lower 55%: thick TORN FELT CROSS SECTION, broader nested layers of compressed short fibre bundles whose edges fray into a few soft strands. Bunches partly pull away but no separated collage pieces. The boundary between bands is a natural gentle horizontal torn transition. Preserve sufficient mid-scale group silhouette; do not fill with equally-sized micro fibres.
